decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical message symbol declaration macros.
evidence: The source matches DOS 6.0 and astro byte for byte.
COMMAND TDATA and TPRINTF include msgdcl.inc.
The file generates PUBLIC/EXTRN declarations for message tables and service symbols on assembler pass one, rather than directly emitting message text or service instructions.
Prior TPRINTF review identified target differences in the separately tracked MSG_SERVICES macro (index 216), and TDATA review records unresolved generated message inputs (reviews 160 and 152).
limitations: Reference identity does not prove target message-service declarations or linkage in all configurations. Generated message sources, the service macro and complete COMMAND.COM link remain to be reconstructed and verified in order.
